name: search_wiki
description: Discover wiki documents whose contents match a bm25 query. Returns the top-ranked matches with `path`, `title`, and a short `snippet` (~60 tokens around the densest match, with matched terms wrapped in `**bold**`). Snippets are for triage only — they are NOT enough context to answer detailed questions or to edit a doc. After identifying the right document(s), call `read_page(path)` to get the full body. Use plain words separated by spaces, or quoted phrases for exact matches. Avoid punctuation like `?` and `:` that the FTS5 parser may reject.

query.description: Search query. Plain words are AND'd together. Use "double quotes" for exact phrases.
